remarks: DAD-IS lists the breeds of several farmed deer species (red deer, sika, fallow deer, reindeer, …) under one species Deer.
Hybrids of dromedary and Bactrian camel.
Mule and mulard ducks, hybrids of the domestic duck and the Muscovy duck.
DAD-IS species Fox, farmed for fur (red and Arctic fox).
DAD-IS species Goose (domestic) covers the domestic forms of both the greylag goose (Anser anser) and the swan goose (Anser cygnoides).
DAD-IS lists the breeds of several partridge and snowcock species under one species Partridge.
DAD-IS lists the breeds of several pheasant, monal and tragopan species under one species Pheasant.
DAD-IS species Polecat, farmed for fur: the ferret, the domestic form of the European polecat.
Most DAD-IS quail breeds are Japanese quail (Coturnix japonica), some are common quail (Coturnix coturnix).
DAD-IS species Swallow: swiftlets farmed for their edible nests.
